title: Gallup Park Butterfly Garden Workday
description:
We'll be focusing on light maintenance and general beautification tasks to help keep this garden looking great for all who visit. We'll weed garden beds, deadhead flowers, plant new flora, transplant as needed, mulch the beds, rake the garden, and remove or trim invasive shrubs to help get this park ready for pollinator season.
Register here: https://cityofannarbor.volunteerhub.com/vv2/event/38381383-aec0-4d30-a6aa-066ad445350b
  • Meeting Location: Gallup Park Butterfly Garden - there is a parking lot right next to it!

title: Volunteers needed: Party in the Park
description:
Help bring the fun back to West Park! The free Party in the Parks series continues this summer with an afternoon filled with music, games, creativity and community connection — and volunteers help make it all possible.
Volunteers will help support activity areas and create a positive experience for guests. During this event, volunteers will assist with a craft station and help monitor inflatables and the game area so children and families can safely enjoy the activities throughout the afternoon. This is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, connect with neighbors and help bring free summer fun to the Ann Arbor community. No prior experience is necessary — staff will provide instructions, supplies and guidance on site. Register here: https://cityofannarbor.volunteerhub.com/vv2/event/6b9b0cd7-978a-403e-a1c8-66c53288a9e8

title: Party in the Park
description: Get ready for an afternoon filled with music, games, creativity and community fun as the free Party in the Parks series returns this summer — with two events across Ann Arbor parks! Enjoy live music from local performer (Schmaltz), an inflatable, hands-on crafts, facepainting, lawn games and food. Saturday, Aug. 15 — West Park, noon to 3 p.m. 715 Chapin St. Bring your friends, family, picnic blankets and dancing shoes for a fun-filled afternoon in the park! More details to follow!

title: Junior Lifeguard Day
venue: Veterans Memorial Park, Veterans Memorial Park-Outdoor pool
description:
Veterans Memorial Park Pool
Come out for a day to see what it takes to be a lifeguard! Children ages 6-12 are invited to join us at Veterans Memorial Park Pool (2150 Jackson Ave.) Activities include: surveillance, lifesaving demonstrations and learning and enforcing the pool rules. Children will learn directly from the lifeguards what makes their job so special. Admission for this event is free but we kindly ask that you preregister.

title: Free Family Trivia Night
description:
Looking for a fun night of friendly competition? Gather your family and join us for Free Family Trivia at the Ann Arbor Senior Center. Questions range in difficulty for kids, teens, and adults, so everyone can participate. Teams may have up to eight people, and each participant must register in advance. Sept. 4; Oct. 2; Nov. 6 and Dec. 4 from 5–6:30 p.m. at the Ann Arbor Senior Center, 1320 Baldwin Ave. Participation is free, but preregistration is required. Space is limited.

Register here: https://secure.rec1.com/MI/city-of-ann-arbor/catalog?filter=c2VhcmNoPTQ0NDk0ODU=


Questions? Contact a2parksEvents@a2gov.org.
